LanguageData.USAC_Apparel_AssaultHelmet.label: assault helmet
LanguageData.USAC_Apparel_AssaultHelmet.description: A lightweight tactical helmet built around a composite plasteel shell. Beyond its integrated ear protection, it takes a range of optional attachments.
LanguageData.USAC_Apparel_HeavyHelmet.label: heavy helmet
LanguageData.USAC_Apparel_HeavyHelmet.description: A full-coverage composite plasteel helmet with reinforced frontal fragment protection. Machine gunners and heavy infantry wear it wherever the fighting on the contact line is heaviest.
LanguageData.USAC_Apparel_MeleeHelmet.label: gladiator helmet
LanguageData.USAC_Apparel_MeleeHelmet.description: A tactical helmet meant for fighting indoors. Its ballistic eyepieces shield the eyes from fragments and burns, though at some angles their reflections make aiming harder.
LanguageData.USAC_Apparel_NightVisionHelmet.label: night vision helmet
LanguageData.USAC_Apparel_NightVisionHelmet.descripti: A lightweight tactical helmet fitted with night vision goggles, which sharply improves shooting in the dark. Its forward center of gravity does slow the wearer's reactions at close range.
